title: Olivier rigidity theorem for weakly etale local maps
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof shows every fibre has exactly one point with unchanged residue field. A hypothetical splitting yields an idempotent after an algebraic field extension, while integral closure over the strictly henselian base forces a local subring that excludes that idempotent; the map is then shown to be a faithfully flat epimorphism.
